text.en: Meena watched the Prime Minister on TV. "What does the Prime Minister do?" she asked.

The Union government has three organs. The legislature is Parliament, consisting of the President, the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha. The Lok Sabha is elected by the people for five years and the Rajya Sabha is a permanent house whose members retire by rotation.
The President is the head of state and acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers. The Prime Minister is the head of government, leads the Council of Ministers and is responsible to the Lok Sabha.
The Supreme Court is the highest court and protects the Constitution. The judiciary is independent and can review laws. Parliament makes laws, passes the budget and watches the executive.
